Structure diagram now has 3 balanced slots (NowAgentAI, NowMoveMe, Venture 03) with V03 rendered subtler (opacity 0.45, hollow ring connector dot vs solid red on live ventures, no ™). New venture-in-development <article> exists directly after venture-nowmoveme with exact body text, 3 correctly-testid'd tags (Enterprise, Industry Solutions, Applied AI), muted text-neutral-500 title (rgb 115,115,115 vs rgb 255,255,255 on live), zero <a> links inside the article, no ™ symbol, and none of the forbidden hype words ('Coming Soon', 'Launch', 'Countdown', 'Beta', 'Preview'). Live venture CTAs (venture-nowagentai-cta -> https://www.nowagentai.com _blank, venture-nowmoveme-cta -> https://www.nowmoveme.co.uk/uk _blank) and their tags/bodies remain intact. ventures-caption present with 'Current ventures powered by Imkindo · more to follow'. Zero console errors on page load. Hero responsive fix at 1440x900 (via CDP Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride) still holding.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: The V03 article uses the 'reveal' animation class which starts at opacity 0 and animates in. Combined with the explicit 'opacity-70' Tailwind class the article settles around 0.98 opacity after the reveal completes (measured), not the intended ~0.7. If a stronger visual muting is desired, consider replacing the reveal opacity animation for this specific article or use inline style opacity that overrides the animation end-state. Functionally still passes 'opacity < 1' but the visual difference from V01/V02 comes primarily from the muted text-neutral-500 title and dashed border on the PlaceholderGlyph rather than article-level opacity.

Structure diagram grid child index note: the grid contains an absolute-positioned horizontal-branch line as first child, so filtering by classes containing 'absolute' is required when programmatically inspecting slots. Not a bug, just a testability observation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 is a purely additive frontend polish — new third slot in the parent-company structure diagram and a new subtle <article data-testid='venture-in-development'> after the two live venture articles. Backend unchanged. All prior iteration 8 flows still pass. If further polish is requested to make the V03 article visually more distinct from live ventures, note that the .reveal animation currently overrides the opacity-70 class at end-state (settles ~0.98 measured); the muting today comes from text-neutral-500 title + dashed PlaceholderGlyph border + no CTA + no ™. Use CDP Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride for viewport-dependent tests — Playwright set_viewport_size does not resize window.innerHeight in this env.
